researcher: claude, from the owner's 2026-10-26 live test and the OpenRouter API reference

facts.claim: OpenRouter's API is OpenAI-compatible: chat completions at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions, so the base URL without /v1 plus the template's /v1 paths reaches it.
facts.evidence: 2026-10-26 live check by the owner's session: a plain service-table row with base https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 returned 200 with a conforming reply (handoff 2026-10-26, section 5).

facts.claim: The key is sent as Authorization: Bearer KEY.
facts.evidence: The same live check sent the key as a bearer header and the model list returned 200.

facts.claim: The default host is openrouter.ai; another OpenAI-compatible host replaces it when you pass --base-url.
GET /v1/models lists the models and is used here as a keyless health probe (the gateway's probe sends no credential).
facts.evidence: The 2026-10-26 live check listed 466 models with the key; whether the list answers without a key was NOT tested here, so a host that requires a key for it will show an error in status while calls still work.

facts.claim: OpenRouter answers 402 when credits run out, 429 when rate limited, and may route to a provider that returns 5xx.
facts.evidence: Read from the error reference; none of the three was provoked against the live service.

choices.decision: one generic template, no fixed provider
choices.because: works for OpenRouter, Together or any host that follows the OpenAI layout; the farm row names the provider

choices.decision: bearer key by store: reference, locality remote, llm.tools none
choices.because: the key never sits in the registry; a remote engine must not be treated as local; a model that cannot act may receive farm packets
the gateway's health probe never sends a credential; it shows the host answers, a wrong key shows on the first call

open: Model ids (for example deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it) are examples from the 2026-10-26 test, not facts: ids change or vanish, and the owner picks the model in the farm row.
Prices and the host's privacy, retention and training settings are the owner's to read and set on the host's account; none is stated here.
The 402, 429 and 5xx behaviour of a live provider has not been provoked; the mapping is tested against a loopback fake.
